description: This file defines two Flutter widgets, Skeleton and CircleSkeleton, which are used as placeholder UI components (skeleton screens) during loading states. It leverages Flutter's Material package and custom constants for styling.

classes.name: Skeleton
classes.description: A widget that displays a rectangular skeleton placeholder, customizable by height, width, layer, and radius.

classes.name: CircleSkeleton
classes.description: A widget that displays a circular skeleton placeholder, customizable by size.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for each skeleton placeholder.
